Funk.symmetricFunk_lower_bound : Funk.FunkLowerBoundGoal
Funk.kalai_full_flags : Funk.KalaiFullFlagsGoal

Funk.symmetricFunk_metric_radius {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (K : Set (Funk.Space n)) (hK : Funk.IsSymmetricConvexBody K)
  {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
  Funk.funkVolume K (1 - Real.exp (-R)) < ⊤ ∧
    ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n / ↑n.factorial * Real.log (2 * Real.exp R - 1) ^ n) ≤ Funk.funkVolume K (1 - Real.exp (-R))

Funk.kalai_halfspace_full_flags {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (P : Set (Funk.Space n)) (hp : Funk.IsFinitePolytope P)
  (hP : Funk.IsSymmetricConvexBody P) :
  Finite (Funk.HalfspaceFullFlag P) ∧ 2 ^ n * n.factorial ≤ Nat.card (Funk.HalfspaceFullFlag P)
'Funk.symmetricFunk_lower_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'Funk.kalai_full_flags' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

FunkVolume.symmetricFunkVolume :
  True ↔
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)),
          FunkVolume.IsSymmetricConvexBody K →
            ∀ (τ : ℝ),
              0 < τ →
                τ < 1 →
                  FunkVolume.funkVolume K τ < ⊤ ∧
                    ENNReal.ofReal ((4 * Real.artanh τ) ^ n / ↑n.factorial) ≤ FunkVolume.funkVolume K τ
'FunkVolume.symmetricFunkVolume' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

Funk.FormalConjectures.kalaiFullFlags :
  True ↔
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (P : Set (Fin n → ℝ)),
          Funk.FormalConjectures.IsFinitePolytope P →
            Funk.FormalConjectures.IsSymmetricConvexBody P →
              Finite (Funk.FormalConjectures.FullFlag P) ∧
                2 ^ n * n.factorial ≤ Nat.card (Funk.FormalConjectures.FullFlag P)
'Funk.FormalConjectures.kalaiFullFlags' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
